tailoring.headline: Senior Java/Spring Boot E-Commerce Developer | SAP Commerce Cloud | 5+ yrs microservices
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering enterprise e-commerce platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell across global markets. Expert in Java, Spring, Spring Boot, RESTful and OCC APIs, microservices, and end-to-end PIM/ERP/MDM integrations. Proven record in designing scalable data pipelines, API migrations, CI/CD deployments, and bridging business and IT through techno-functional analysis, user stories and stakeholder collaboration.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Experienced Ecommerce Java/Spring Boot Engineer
cover_en.hook: I am excited about Wipro’s vision to scale e-commerce solutions with modern Java/Spring Boot microservices. With 5+ years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise that aligns perfectly with this role.

bullets.label: Java/Spring Expertise
bullets.text: At Rockwell Automation I designed and implemented backend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring, delivering robust e-commerce features that align with Wipro’s Java/Spring Boot microservices focus.

bullets.label: API & Integration
bullets.text: I built and exposed OCC REST Web Services and engineered PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines, ensuring seamless integration with ERP and MDM systems—matching Wipro’s need for scalable API-driven commerce solutions.

bullets.label: Microservices & CI/CD
bullets.text: Through CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) and microservice-oriented design, I delivered reliable, continuously delivered services, supporting rapid scaling as required by Wipro.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Leadership
bullets.text: Working in a techno-functional role, I gathered business requirements, wrote user stories and functional specs, and guided international teams, providing the cross-functional collaboration Wipro values.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, Germany, I hold a valid German work permit, am serving notice until 15 December 2026 and can start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to Wipro’s e-commerce initiatives.

tailoring.why_company: Wipro’s reputation as a global leader in digital transformation and its ambitious e-commerce portfolio inspire me. The company’s commitment to leveraging cutting-edge Java/Spring microservices to create scalable, customer-centric experiences aligns with my passion for building robust commerce platforms. I am eager to contribute my SAP Commerce Cloud expertise to Wipro’s innovative projects and help drive measurable business growth for its worldwide clients.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to join Wipro to apply my SAP Commerce Cloud and Java/Spring microservices expertise to accelerate its e-commerce innovations and deliver high-impact, scalable solutions for global customers.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years of Java/Spring experience. I’m excited about Wipro’s e-commerce initiatives and would love to discuss how I can add value. Let’s connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Experienced Ecommerce Java/Spring Boot Engineer – Wipro
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Experienced Ecommerce Java/Spring Boot Engineer position at Wipro. With 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am ready to contribute to your e-commerce transformation.

Kind regards,
